datasets.name: 254b612a
queryLines:
with KPI as
(
SELECT client_name, client, category, traveler, traveler_country, travel_sector, travel_class, destination_country, 
origin_country_name, air_direct_indicator, employee_id, air_rail_alternative, budget_field, budget_field_value,sum(co2_emission_budget) as co2_emission_budget ,
sum(air_od_segment_count) as total_od_segment_count,
sum(rail_segment_count) as total_rail_segment_count,
(case
  when right(traveler,3)= "MRS" then left(traveler,length(traveler)-4)
  when (right(traveler,2)= "MR" OR right(traveler,2)= "MS" OR right(traveler,2)= "DR") then left(traveler,length(traveler)-3)
  when right(traveler,4)= "MISS" then left(traveler,length(traveler)-5)
  else traveler end) as traveler_clean,
case when traveler_clean = '********' then employee_id else traveler_clean end as employeeid_traveler,
sum(adv_booking_days) as Total_advance_booking_days,
(CASE
    WHEN :select_column = 'country (POS)' THEN traveler_country
    WHEN :select_column = 'traveler' THEN traveler
    WHEN :select_column = 'travel_sector' THEN travel_sector
    WHEN :select_column = 'travel_class' THEN travel_class
    WHEN :select_column = 'category' THEN category
    ELSE traveler_country
  END) as dimension,
(CASE
    WHEN :select_column2 = 'country (POS)' THEN traveler_country
    WHEN :select_column2 = 'traveler' THEN traveler
    WHEN :select_column2 = 'travel_sector' THEN travel_sector
    WHEN :select_column2 = 'travel_class' THEN travel_class
    WHEN :select_column2 = 'category' THEN category
    ELSE category
  END) as dimension2,
  SUM(component_count) AS trip_component,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emissions_advito
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emissions_advito_wo_rf
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emissions_defra
      ELSE co2_emissions_advito
    END
  ) AS total_selected_co2_emissions,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emissions_advito
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emissions_advito_wo_rf
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emissions_defra
      ELSE co2_emissions_advito
    END
  )*(:emissioncost) as environmental_impact,
  CASE
    WHEN :dateperiod = 'Invoice date' THEN invoice_date
    ELSE travel_start_date
  END AS selected_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN selected_date between :current_period.min AND :current_period.max THEN 'current'
    WHEN selected_date between :previous_period.min AND :previous_period.max THEN 'previous'
    ELSE null
  END AS period,
  sum(
    CASE
      WHEN :currencycode = 'USD' THEN currency_rate_usd * total_amount_gross 
      WHEN :currencycode = 'EUR' THEN currency_rate_eur * total_amount_gross
      WHEN :currencycode = 'GBP' THEN currency_rate_gbp * total_amount_gross
      ELSE currency_rate_usd * total_amount_gross
    END
  ) AS gross_amount_selected,
  (case when :select_metric = 'Emissions' then total_selected_co2_emissions
  when :select_metric = 'Gross Spend' then gross_amount_selected
  when :select_metric = 'Components' then trip_component 
  else total_selected_co2_emissions end) as selected_metric
FROM bcd_adv_workspace_poc.test.advito_poc
-- WHERE client_id = __aibi_external_value
GROUP BY client_name, client, category,  traveler, traveler_country, travel_sector, travel_class,  destination_country, origin_country_name, 
air_direct_indicator, employee_id, air_rail_alternative,budget_field,budget_field_value,
  CASE WHEN :dateperiod = 'Invoice date' THEN invoice_date ELSE travel_start_date END,
  (case
  when right(traveler,3)= "MRS" then left(traveler,length(traveler)-4)
  when (right(traveler,2)= "MR" OR right(traveler,2)= "MS" OR right(traveler,2)= "DR") then left(traveler,length(traveler)-3)
  when right(traveler,4)= "MISS" then left(traveler,length(traveler)-5)
  else traveler end), 
  case when traveler_clean = '********' then employee_id else traveler_clean end
), 

final as (
SELECT KPI.*,
 try_divide(case when period = 'current' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'current' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end) over (partition by dimension)
  ) as co2_emissions_current_share_dimension,
  try_divide(case when period = 'current' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'current' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end) over ()
  ) as co2_emissions_current_share,
  try_divide(case when period = 'current' then gross_amount_selected else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'current' then gross_amount_selected else 0 end) over ()
  ) as gross_amount_current_share,
  try_divide(case when period = 'current' then trip_component else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'current' then trip_component else 0 end) over ()
  ) as components_current_share,
  try_divide(case when period = 'previous' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'previous' then total_selected_co2_emissions else 0 end) over ()
  ) as co2_emissions_previous_share,
  try_divide(case when period = 'previous' then gross_amount_selected else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'previous' then gross_amount_selected else 0 end) over ()
  ) as gross_amount_previous_share,
  try_divide(case when period = 'previous' then trip_component else 0 end,sum(case when period = 'previous' then trip_component else 0 end) over ()
  ) as components_previous_share,
  sum(case when period = 'current' then total_od_segment_count else 0 end) over (partition by employeeid_traveler) as traveler_count_attribute
 FROM KPI
)
select final.*,
  case when traveler_count_attribute > :roadwarrior_threshold then 'Road Warrior'
  when :roadwarrior_threshold >= traveler_count_attribute and traveler_count_attribute >= :freqtraveler_threshold then 'Frequent Traveler'
  when :freqtraveler_threshold >= traveler_count_attribute then 'Occasional Traveler' else NULL end as traveler_type,
  cast(year(selected_date) as string) as year, 
  date_format(selected_date, 'MMMM') as month
from final

datasets.displayName: Single Day Carbon Emission Year Over Year Analysis Dataset
queryLines:
WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_date,
    co2_emissions_advito
  FROM bcd_adv_workspace_poc.test.summarydataset _table
  WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE('2025-11-28') AND DATE('2025-11-28')
),
emissions_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(invoice_date) AS year,
    SUM(co2_emissions_advito) AS total_emissions
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY YEAR(invoice_date)
),
yoy_calc AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    total_emissions,
    LAG(total_emissions) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_emissions
  FROM emissions_by_year
)
SELECT
  year,
  total_emissions,
  prev_year_emissions,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_year_emissions IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ((total_emissions - prev_year_emissions) / prev_year_emissions) * 100
  END AS yoy_emission_percent
FROM yoy_calc
ORDER BY year

-- Baseline (historical) emissions up to :base_year
WITH carbon_budgeting AS (
  SELECT
    g4i.client_id,
    CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT) AS report_travel_year,
    CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT) AS report_invoice_year,
    g4i.category,
    g4i.traveler,
    g4i.client_field_1,
    g4i.client_field_2,
    g4i.client_field_3,
    g4i.client_field_4,
    g4i.client_field_5,
    g4i.client_field_6,
    g4i.client_field_7,
    g4i.client_field_8,
    g4i.client_field_9,
    g4i.client_field_10,
    g4i.travel_class,
    g4i.travel_sector,
    g4i.air_trip_indicator,
    g4i.air_trip_length,
    g4i.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    g4i.air_rail_alternative,
    g4i.air_rail_co2_factor,
    g4i.air_rail_train_distance,
    g4i.car_fuel_type,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.component_count AS DOUBLE))            AS component_count,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.air_od_segment_count AS DOUBLE))       AS segment_count,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE))       AS co2_emission_advito,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_defra AS DOUBLE))        AS co2_emission_defra,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito_wo_rf AS DOUBLE)) AS co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_defra_wo_rf AS DOUBLE))  AS co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS forecast_emissions
  FROM bcd_adv_workspace_poc.test.qs_gate4_insights g4i
  WHERE try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE) <> 0
    AND CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date'  THEN CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
          ELSE CAST(g4i.report_travel_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
        END
  GROUP BY
    g4i.client_id,
    CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT),
    CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT),
    g4i.category,
    g4i.traveler,
    g4i.client_field_1,
    g4i.client_field_2,
    g4i.client_field_3,
    g4i.client_field_4,
    g4i.client_field_5,
    g4i.client_field_6,
    g4i.client_field_7,
    g4i.client_field_8,
    g4i.client_field_9,
    g4i.client_field_10,
    g4i.travel_class,
    g4i.travel_sector,
    g4i.air_trip_indicator,
    g4i.air_trip_length,
    g4i.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    g4i.air_rail_alternative,
    g4i.air_rail_co2_factor,
    g4i.air_rail_train_distance,
    g4i.car_fuel_type
),

-- Max historical year per client
max_date_type AS (
  SELECT
    client_id,
    MAX(report_travel_year)  AS mx_report_travel_year,
    MAX(report_invoice_year) AS mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM carbon_budgeting
  GROUP BY client_id
),

-- Forecast rows using explode(sequence(...))
carbon_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    a.client_id,
    seq_year AS report_travel_year,
    seq_year AS report_invoice_year,
    a.category,
    a.traveler,
    a.client_field_1,
    a.client_field_2,
    a.client_field_3,
    a.client_field_4,
    a.client_field_5,
    a.client_field_6,
    a.client_field_7,
    a.client_field_8,
    a.client_field_9,
    a.client_field_10,
    a.travel_class,
    a.travel_sector,
    a.air_trip_indicator,
    a.air_trip_length,
    a.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    a.air_rail_alternative,
    a.air_rail_co2_factor,
    a.air_rail_train_distance,
    a.car_fuel_type,
    a.component_count,
    a.segment_count,
    a.co2_emission_advito,
    a.co2_emission_defra,
    a.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    a.co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS forecast_emissions
  FROM carbon_budgeting a
  JOIN max_date_type m ON m.client_id = a.client_id
  LATERAL VIEW explode(
    sequence(
      CASE WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date' THEN m.mx_report_travel_year + 1
        WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN m.mx_report_invoice_year + 1
        ELSE m.mx_report_travel_year + 1 END,
      CAST(:target_year AS INT)
    )
  ) seq AS seq_year
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date'  THEN a.report_travel_year  = m.mx_report_travel_year
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.report_invoice_year = m.mx_report_invoice_year
          ELSE a.report_travel_year        = m.mx_report_travel_year
        END
)

-- Final union + aggregation
SELECT
  CAST(x.client_id AS STRING) AS client_id,
  x.category,
  x.traveler,
  make_date(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1)  AS report_travel_year,
  make_date(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1) AS report_invoice_year,
  x.client_field_1,
  x.client_field_2,
  x.client_field_3,
  x.client_field_4,
  x.client_field_5,
  x.client_field_6,
  x.client_field_7,
  x.client_field_8,
  x.client_field_9,
  x.client_field_10,
  x.travel_class,
  x.travel_sector,
  x.air_trip_indicator,
  x.air_trip_length,
  x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  x.air_rail_alternative,
  x.air_rail_co2_factor,
  x.air_rail_train_distance,
  x.car_fuel_type,
  SUM(x.component_count) AS component_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT x.traveler) AS traveler_count,
  SUM(x.segment_count) AS segment_count,
  SUM(x.co2_emission_advito) AS co2_emission_advito,
  SUM(x.co2_emission_defra) AS co2_emission_defra,
  SUM(x.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf) AS co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
  SUM(x.co2_emission_defra_wo_rf) AS co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS forecast_emissions
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM carbon_budgeting
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM carbon_forecast
) x
GROUP BY
  x.client_id,
  x.category,
  x.traveler,
  x.report_travel_year,
  x.report_invoice_year,
  x.client_field_1,
  x.client_field_2,
  x.client_field_3,
  x.client_field_4,
  x.client_field_5,
  x.client_field_6,
  x.client_field_7,
  x.client_field_8,
  x.client_field_9,
  x.client_field_10,
  x.travel_class,
  x.travel_sector,
  x.air_trip_indicator,
  x.air_trip_length,
  x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  x.air_rail_alternative,
  x.air_rail_co2_factor,
  x.air_rail_train_distance,
  x.car_fuel_type

    a.component_count,
    a.segment_count,
    a.co2_emission_advito,
    a.co2_emission_defra,
    a.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    a.co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
    --SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(seq_year) = :base_year THEN `co2_emission_advito` ELSE 0 END) / 1000 as emission_base_year,
    max(CAST(a.report_travel_year  AS INT)) over () as mx_report_travel_year,
    max(CAST(a.report_invoice_year  AS INT)) over () as mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM carbon_budgeting a
  -- cross JOIN max_date_type m ON m.client_id <=> a.client_id (left join to cross join for testing purposes as dataset doesn't have client id)
  LATERAL VIEW explode(
    sequence(
        case WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN mx_report_invoice_year + 1
        ELSE mx_report_travel_year + 1 END,
      CAST(:target_year AS INT)
    )
  ) seq AS seq_year
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.report_invoice_year = mx_report_invoice_year
          ELSE a.report_travel_year        = mx_report_travel_year
        END
),

-- Final union + aggregation

  final as (
  SELECT
  CAST(x.client_id AS STRING) AS client_id,
  x.category,
  x.traveler,
  make_date(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1)  AS report_travel_year,
  make_date(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1) AS report_invoice_year,
  CASE
    WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN make_date(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1)
    ELSE make_date(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1)
  END AS selected_year,
  sum(CASE
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN x.co2_emission_advito
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN x.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
      WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN x.co2_emission_defra
      ELSE x.co2_emission_advito
    END)
  AS co2_emissions_selected,
  x.client_field_1,
  x.client_field_2,
  x.client_field_3,
  x.client_field_4,
  x.client_field_5,
  x.client_field_6,
  x.client_field_7,
  x.client_field_8,
  x.client_field_9,
  x.client_field_10,
  x.travel_class,
  x.travel_sector,
  x.air_trip_indicator,
  x.air_trip_length,
  x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  x.air_rail_alternative,
  x.air_rail_co2_factor,
  x.air_rail_train_distance,
  x.car_fuel_type,
  SUM(x.component_count) AS component_count,
  SUM(x.segment_count) AS segment_count
  FROM (
  SELECT * FROM carbon_budgeting
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM carbon_forecast
) x
  GROUP BY
  x.client_id,
  x.category,
  x.traveler,
  x.report_travel_year,
  x.report_invoice_year,
  x.client_field_1,
  x.client_field_2,
  x.client_field_3,
  x.client_field_4,
  x.client_field_5,
  x.client_field_6,
  x.client_field_7,
  x.client_field_8,
  x.client_field_9,
  x.client_field_10,
  x.travel_class,
  x.travel_sector,
  x.air_trip_indicator,
  x.air_trip_length,
  x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  x.air_rail_alternative,
  x.air_rail_co2_factor,
  x.air_rail_train_distance,
  x.car_fuel_type
)
,

calc_layer_1 AS 
( SELECT *, 
  sum(CASE 
  WHEN YEAR(selected_year) = :base_year  then co2_emissions_selected
  when YEAR(selected_year) > :base_year THEN co2_emissions_selected * (1 - (CASE WHEN travel_class IN ('MPV', 'Dual Purpose 4X4', 'Luxury', 'Executive', 'Sports')
 THEN :car_shift_medium_vehicle / 100.0 * (1 - (:car_ref_savings_medium_vehicle / 100.0)) ELSE 0 END)) END) as emission_forecast_car,
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(selected_year) = :base_year THEN co2_emissions_selected ELSE 0 END) / 1000 as emission_baseyear,
  sum(case when year(selected_year) = :baseline_year then co2_emissions_selected ELSE 0 end) / 1000 as emissions_baselineyear,
  SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(selected_year) <= :base_year THEN co2_emissions_selected ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS past_emission,
  sum(CASE 
  WHEN travel_class = 'Luxury' THEN 
    co2_emissions_selected * (1 - (:cfShiftluxuryhotel / 100.0)) 
    - (:cfShiftluxuryhotel / 100.0) * (co2_emissions_selected * :cfRefSavingsLuxToUU / 100.0)
  ELSE co2_emissions_selected
END) as emissions_forecast_hotel
from final
  group by
  client_id,
  category, 
  traveler,
  report_travel_year,
  report_invoice_year,
  client_field_1,
  client_field_2,
  client_field_3,
  client_field_4,
  client_field_5,
  client_field_6,
  client_field_7,
  client_field_8,
  client_field_9,
  client_field_10,
  travel_class,
  travel_sector,
  air_trip_indicator,
  air_trip_length,
  air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  air_rail_alternative,
  air_rail_co2_factor,
  air_rail_train_distance,
  car_fuel_type,
  component_count,
  segment_count,
  selected_year,
  co2_emissions_selected),
calc_layer_2 AS (
SELECT *,
CASE 
  WHEN datediff(
    YEAR,
    make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
    selected_year
  ) < 0 THEN NULL
  WHEN datediff(
    YEAR,
    make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
    selected_year
  ) = 0 THEN co2_emissions_selected
  WHEN category = 'Hotel' THEN emissions_forecast_hotel
  when category = 'Car' then emission_forecast_car
  ELSE co2_emissions_selected
END as emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE,
CASE
  WHEN datediff(
    YEAR,
    make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
    selected_year
  ) = 0 THEN emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE
  WHEN category = 'Hotel' THEN 
    emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE * POWER(
      1 - (:cfRefHotelEnergyEfficiency / 100.0),
      datediff(
        YEAR,
        make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
        selected_year
      )
    )
  WHEN category = 'Air' THEN 
    emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE 
    * (1 - (:cfShiftefficientaircraft / 100.0) * (:cfRefAirEfficiencyGain / 100.0))
    * POWER(
      1 - (:cfRefAircraftEfficiencyImpr / 100.0),
      datediff(
        YEAR,
        make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
        selected_year
      )
    )
  ELSE emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE
END as emissions_forecast_wEFF_woFTE,
emissions_forecast_wEFF_woFTE * POWER(
  1 + (:cfFTEincrease / 100.0),
  datediff(
    YEAR,
    make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
    selected_year
  )
) as emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE,  
CASE 
  WHEN selected_year <= make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1) THEN 0
  WHEN CAST(:cfRefSAFprice AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE try_divide(CAST(:cfSAF AS DOUBLE), CAST(:cfRefSAFprice AS DOUBLE))
END as forecast_saf,
CASE
     WHEN YEAR(selected_year) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) < 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN YEAR(selected_year) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) = 0 THEN co2_emissions_selected
      ELSE co2_emissions_selected * POWER(1 + (:cfFTEincrease / 100.0), YEAR(selected_year) - CAST(:base_year AS INT))
    END    AS Forecast_Emissions_BAU,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(traveler, 3) = 'MRS' THEN LEFT(traveler, LENGTH(traveler) - 4)
    WHEN RIGHT(traveler, 2) IN ('MR', 'MS', 'DR') THEN LEFT(traveler, LENGTH(traveler) - 3)
    WHEN RIGHT(traveler, 4) = 'MISS' THEN LEFT(traveler, LENGTH(traveler) - 5)
    ELSE traveler
  END as traveler_clean
from calc_layer_1
group by
  client_id,
  category, 
  traveler,
  report_travel_year,
  report_invoice_year,
  client_field_1,
  client_field_2,
  client_field_3,
  client_field_4,
  client_field_5,
  client_field_6,
  client_field_7,
  client_field_8,
  client_field_9,
  client_field_10,
  travel_class,
  travel_sector,
  air_trip_indicator,
  air_trip_length,
  air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
  air_rail_alternative,
  air_rail_co2_factor,
  air_rail_train_distance,
  car_fuel_type,
  component_count,
  segment_count,
  selected_year,
  co2_emissions_selected,
  emissions_forecast_hotel,
  emission_forecast_car,
  emission_baseyear,
  emissions_baselineyear,
  past_emission,traveler_clean
  ),
 calc_layer_3 AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE) / 1000 - AVG(forecast_saf) AS Forecast_Emissions_Scenario,
    CASE 
      WHEN past_emission IS NOT NULL AND 
           (SUM(emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE) / 1000 - AVG(forecast_saf)) IS NOT NULL 
        THEN past_emission
      ELSE COALESCE(past_emission, 0) + COALESCE(SUM(emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE) / 1000 - AVG(forecast_saf), 0)
    END AS past_forecast_emissions,
    SUM(Forecast_Emissions_BAU)/1000 AS Forecast_Emissions_BAU1,
    --try_divide(Forecast_Emissions_Scenario, Forecast_Emissions_BAU1) - 1 AS forecast_bau_vs_scenario_var
   
    CASE
  WHEN DATEDIFF(
         make_date(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1),
         CASE WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN MIN(report_invoice_year) ELSE MIN(report_travel_year) END
       ) / 365 <= 0
    THEN NULLIF(
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category IN ('Hotel', 'Air', 'Rail') THEN traveler_clean END),
           0
         )
    ELSE NULLIF(
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category IN ('Hotel', 'Air', 'Rail') THEN traveler_clean END),
           0
         ) * POWER(
           1 + :cfFTEincrease / 100.0,
           YEAR(
             CASE WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN MIN(report_invoice_year) ELSE MIN(report_travel_year) END
           ) - CAST(:base_year AS INT)
         )
END as fte_forecast_v2
  FROM calc_layer_2
  GROUP BY
    client_id,
    category, 
    traveler,
    report_travel_year,
    report_invoice_year,
    client_field_1,
    client_field_2,
    client_field_3,
    client_field_4,
    client_field_5,
    client_field_6,
    client_field_7,
    client_field_8,
    client_field_9,
    client_field_10,
    travel_class,
    travel_sector,
    air_trip_indicator,
    air_trip_length,
    air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    air_rail_alternative,
    air_rail_co2_factor,
    air_rail_train_distance,
    car_fuel_type,
    component_count,
    segment_count,
    selected_year,
    co2_emissions_selected,
    emissions_forecast_hotel,
    emission_forecast_car,
    emission_baseyear,
    emissions_baselineyear,
    past_emission,
    emissions_forecast_wEFF_woFTE,
    emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE,
    emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE,
    forecast_saf,Forecast_Emissions_BAU,traveler_clean
)
  select * from calc_layer_3

-- Baseline (historical) emissions up to :base_year
WITH carbon_budgeting AS (
  SELECT
    g4i.client_id,
    CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT) AS report_travel_year,
    CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT) AS report_invoice_year,
    g4i.category,
    g4i.traveler,
    g4i.client_field_1,
    g4i.client_field_2,
    g4i.client_field_3,
    g4i.client_field_4,
    g4i.client_field_5,
    g4i.client_field_6,
    g4i.client_field_7,
    g4i.client_field_8,
    g4i.client_field_9,
    g4i.client_field_10,
    g4i.travel_class,
    g4i.travel_sector,
    g4i.air_trip_indicator,
    g4i.air_trip_length,
    g4i.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    g4i.air_rail_alternative,
    g4i.air_rail_co2_factor,
    g4i.air_rail_train_distance,
    g4i.car_fuel_type,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.component_count AS DOUBLE))            AS component_count,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.air_od_segment_count AS DOUBLE))       AS segment_count,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE))       AS co2_emission_advito,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_defra AS DOUBLE))        AS co2_emission_defra,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito_wo_rf AS DOUBLE)) AS co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    SUM(try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_defra_wo_rf AS DOUBLE))  AS co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
    MAX(CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT)) OVER () AS mx_report_travel_year,
    MAX(CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT)) OVER () AS mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM bcd_adv_workspace_poc.test.qs_gate4_insights g4i
  WHERE try_cast(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE) <> 0
    AND CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date'  THEN CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
          ELSE CAST(g4i.report_travel_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
        END
  GROUP BY
    g4i.client_id,
    CAST(g4i.report_travel_year  AS INT),
    CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT),
    g4i.category,
    g4i.traveler,
    g4i.client_field_1,
    g4i.client_field_2,
    g4i.client_field_3,
    g4i.client_field_4,
    g4i.client_field_5,
    g4i.client_field_6,
    g4i.client_field_7,
    g4i.client_field_8,
    g4i.client_field_9,
    g4i.client_field_10,
    g4i.travel_class,
    g4i.travel_sector,
    g4i.air_trip_indicator,
    g4i.air_trip_length,
    g4i.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    g4i.air_rail_alternative,
    g4i.air_rail_co2_factor,
    g4i.air_rail_train_distance,
    g4i.car_fuel_type
),

-- Forecast rows using explode(sequence(...))
carbon_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    a.client_id,
    seq_year AS report_travel_year,
    seq_year AS report_invoice_year,
    a.category,
    a.traveler,
    a.client_field_1,
    a.client_field_2,
    a.client_field_3,
    a.client_field_4,
    a.client_field_5,
    a.client_field_6,
    a.client_field_7,
    a.client_field_8,
    a.client_field_9,
    a.client_field_10,
    a.travel_class,
    a.travel_sector,
    a.air_trip_indicator,
    a.air_trip_length,
    a.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    a.air_rail_alternative,
    a.air_rail_co2_factor,
    a.air_rail_train_distance,
    a.car_fuel_type,
    a.component_count,
    a.segment_count,
    a.co2_emission_advito,
    a.co2_emission_defra,
    a.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    a.co2_emission_defra_wo_rf,
    a.mx_report_travel_year,
    a.mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM carbon_budgeting a
  LATERAL VIEW explode(
    sequence(
      CASE 
        WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date' THEN a.mx_report_travel_year + 1
        WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.mx_report_invoice_year + 1
        ELSE a.mx_report_travel_year + 1 
      END,
      CAST(:target_year AS INT)
    )
  ) seq AS seq_year
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Travel date'  THEN a.report_travel_year  = a.mx_report_travel_year
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.report_invoice_year = a.mx_report_invoice_year
          ELSE a.report_travel_year = a.mx_report_travel_year
        END
),

-- Pre-compute baseline emissions once
baseline_emissions AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emission_advito
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emission_defra
        ELSE co2_emission_advito
      END
    ) / 1000.0 AS emission_baseyear,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN report_travel_year = CAST(:baseline_year AS INT) THEN
          CASE
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emission_advito
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emission_defra
            ELSE co2_emission_advito
          END
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) / 1000.0 AS emissions_baselineyear
  FROM carbon_budgeting
  WHERE report_travel_year = CAST(:base_year AS INT) OR report_travel_year = CAST(:baseline_year AS INT)
),

-- Union and aggregate
combined_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(x.client_id AS STRING) AS client_id,
    x.category,
    x.traveler,
    MAKE_DATE(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1) AS report_travel_year,
    MAKE_DATE(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1) AS report_invoice_year,
    CASE
      WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN MAKE_DATE(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1)
      ELSE MAKE_DATE(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1)
    END AS selected_year,
    x.client_field_1,
    x.client_field_2,
    x.client_field_3,
    x.client_field_4,
    x.client_field_5,
    x.client_field_6,
    x.client_field_7,
    x.client_field_8,
    x.client_field_9,
    x.client_field_10,
    x.travel_class,
    x.travel_sector,
    x.air_trip_indicator,
    x.air_trip_length,
    x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    x.air_rail_alternative,
    x.air_rail_co2_factor,
    x.air_rail_train_distance,
    x.car_fuel_type,
    SUM(x.component_count) AS component_count,
    SUM(x.segment_count) AS segment_count,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN x.co2_emission_advito
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN x.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN x.co2_emission_defra
        ELSE x.co2_emission_advito
      END
    ) AS co2_emissions_selected
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM carbon_budgeting
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM carbon_forecast
  ) x
  GROUP BY
    x.client_id,
    x.category,
    x.traveler,
    x.report_travel_year,
    x.report_invoice_year,
    x.client_field_1,
    x.client_field_2,
    x.client_field_3,
    x.client_field_4,
    x.client_field_5,
    x.client_field_6,
    x.client_field_7,
    x.client_field_8,
    x.client_field_9,
    x.client_field_10,
    x.travel_class,
    x.travel_sector,
    x.air_trip_indicator,
    x.air_trip_length,
    x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    x.air_rail_alternative,
    x.air_rail_co2_factor,
    x.air_rail_train_distance,
    x.car_fuel_type
)

-- Final select with cross join to baseline
SELECT 
  cd.*,
  be.emission_baseyear,
  be.emissions_baselineyear
FROM combined_data cd
CROSS JOIN baseline_emissions be

columns.description: Forecasted car emissions with vehicle type shifts and efficiency savings applied for future years
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) >= :base_year THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (1 - (CASE WHEN `car_fuel_type` IN ('MPV', 'Dual Purpose 4X4', 'Luxury', 'Executive', 'Sports') THEN :car_shift_medium_vehicle / 100.0 ELSE 0 END)) - (CASE WHEN `car_fuel_type` IN ('MPV', 'Dual Purpose 4X4', 'Luxury', 'Executive', 'Sports') THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (:car_shift_medium_vehicle / 100.0) * (:car_ref_savings_medium_vehicle / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END

columns.description: Forecasted air emissions with cabin downgrades and efficiency savings applied for future years
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) >= :base_year THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (1 - (CASE WHEN `travel_class` IN ('Business', 'First') THEN :air_cabin_downgrade / 100.0 ELSE 0 END)) - (CASE WHEN `travel_class` IN ('Business', 'First') THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (:air_cabin_downgrade / 100.0) * (:air_cabin_savings / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END

columns.description: Forecasted emissions with air-to-rail modal shift applied for routes with rail alternatives
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) >= :base_year AND `air_rail_alternative` = 'Y' THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (1 - :rail_shift_rate / 100.0) ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END

columns.description: Total forecasted emissions combining all reduction scenarios by travel category
columns.expression: CASE WHEN `category` = 'Car' THEN `emissions_forecast_car` WHEN `category` = 'Air' THEN `emissions_forecast_air` ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END

columns.description: Percentage reduction in emissions compared to baseline
columns.expression: CASE WHEN `co2_emissions_selected` > 0 THEN (`emissions_reduction_amount` / `co2_emissions_selected`) * 100 ELSE 0 END

    SUM(TRY_CAST(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE)) AS co2_emission_advito,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(g4i.co2_emissions_defra AS DOUBLE)) AS co2_emission_defra,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(g4i.co2_emissions_advito_wo_rf AS DOUBLE)) AS co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    MAX(CAST(g4i.report_travel_year AS INT)) OVER () AS mx_report_travel_year,
    MAX(CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT)) OVER () AS mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM bcd_adv_workspace_poc.test.qs_gate4_insights g4i
  WHERE TRY_CAST(g4i.co2_emissions_advito AS DOUBLE) <> 0
    AND CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
          ELSE CAST(g4i.report_travel_year AS INT) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT)
        END
  GROUP BY
    g4i.client_id,
    CAST(g4i.report_travel_year AS INT),
    CAST(g4i.report_invoice_year AS INT),
    g4i.category,
    g4i.traveler,
    g4i.client_field_1,
    g4i.client_field_2,
    g4i.client_field_3,
    g4i.client_field_4,
    g4i.client_field_5,
    g4i.travel_class,
    g4i.travel_sector,
    g4i.air_trip_indicator,
    g4i.air_trip_length,
    g4i.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    g4i.air_rail_alternative,
    g4i.car_fuel_type
),

carbon_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    a.client_id,
    seq_year AS report_travel_year,
    seq_year AS report_invoice_year,
    a.category,
    a.traveler,
    a.client_field_1,
    a.client_field_2,
    a.client_field_3,
    a.client_field_4,
    a.client_field_5,
    a.travel_class,
    a.travel_sector,
    a.air_trip_indicator,
    a.air_trip_length,
    a.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    a.air_rail_alternative,
    a.car_fuel_type,
    a.component_count,
    a.segment_count,
    a.co2_emission_advito,
    a.co2_emission_defra,
    a.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf,
    a.mx_report_travel_year,
    a.mx_report_invoice_year
  FROM carbon_budgeting a
  LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(
    SEQUENCE(
      CASE WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.mx_report_invoice_year + 1
           ELSE a.mx_report_travel_year + 1 END,
      CAST(:target_year AS INT)
    )
  ) seq AS seq_year
  WHERE CASE
          WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN a.report_invoice_year = a.mx_report_invoice_year
          ELSE a.report_travel_year = a.mx_report_travel_year
        END
),

baseline_emissions AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emission_advito
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emission_defra
        ELSE co2_emission_advito
      END
    ) / 1000.0 AS emission_baseyear,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN report_travel_year = CAST(:baseline_year AS INT) THEN
          CASE
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN co2_emission_advito
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
            WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN co2_emission_defra
            ELSE co2_emission_advito
          END
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) / 1000.0 AS emissions_baselineyear
  FROM carbon_budgeting
  WHERE report_travel_year = CAST(:base_year AS INT) OR report_travel_year = CAST(:baseline_year AS INT)
),

combined_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(x.client_id AS STRING) AS client_id,
    x.category,
    x.traveler,
    MAKE_DATE(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1) AS report_travel_year,
    MAKE_DATE(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1) AS report_invoice_year,
    CASE
      WHEN :date_type = 'Invoice date' THEN MAKE_DATE(x.report_invoice_year, 1, 1)
      ELSE MAKE_DATE(x.report_travel_year, 1, 1)
    END AS selected_year,
    x.client_field_1,
    x.client_field_2,
    x.client_field_3,
    x.client_field_4,
    x.client_field_5,
    x.travel_class,
    x.travel_sector,
    x.air_trip_indicator,
    x.air_trip_length,
    x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    x.air_rail_alternative,
    x.car_fuel_type,
    SUM(x.component_count) AS component_count,
    SUM(x.segment_count) AS segment_count,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO' THEN x.co2_emission_advito
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'ADVITO_wo_RF' THEN x.co2_emission_advito_wo_rf
        WHEN :select_emissions_methodology = 'DEFRA' THEN x.co2_emission_defra
        ELSE x.co2_emission_advito
      END
    ) AS co2_emissions_selected
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM carbon_budgeting
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM carbon_forecast
  ) x
  GROUP BY
    x.client_id,
    x.category,
    x.traveler,
    x.report_travel_year,
    x.report_invoice_year,
    x.client_field_1,
    x.client_field_2,
    x.client_field_3,
    x.client_field_4,
    x.client_field_5,
    x.travel_class,
    x.travel_sector,
    x.air_trip_indicator,
    x.air_trip_length,
    x.air_fuel_efficiency_type_id,
    x.air_rail_alternative,
    x.car_fuel_type
)

SELECT 
  cd.*,
  be.emission_baseyear,
  be.emissions_baselineyear
FROM combined_data cd
CROSS JOIN baseline_emissions be

columns.description: Number of years from base year to selected year
columns.expression: YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT)

columns.description: Cleaned traveler name without titles
columns.expression: CASE WHEN RIGHT(`traveler`, 3) = 'MRS' THEN LEFT(`traveler`, LENGTH(`traveler`) - 4) WHEN RIGHT(`traveler`, 2) IN ('MR', 'MS', 'DR') THEN LEFT(`traveler`, LENGTH(`traveler`) - 3) WHEN RIGHT(`traveler`, 4) = 'MISS' THEN LEFT(`traveler`, LENGTH(`traveler`) - 5) ELSE `traveler` END

columns.description: Car emissions forecast with medium vehicle shift (20%) and savings (15%)
columns.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) = CAST(:base_year AS INT) THEN `co2_emissions_selected` WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) > CAST(:base_year AS INT) THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (1 - (CASE WHEN `travel_class` IN ('MPV', 'Dual Purpose 4X4', 'Luxury', 'Executive', 'Sports') THEN 0.20 * (1 - 0.15) ELSE 0 END)) ELSE 0 END)

columns.description: Hotel emissions forecast with luxury shift (10%) and savings (25%)
columns.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN `travel_class` = 'Luxury' THEN `co2_emissions_selected` * (1 - 0.10) - 0.10 * (`co2_emissions_selected` * 0.25) ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END)

columns.description: Emissions forecast without efficiency or FTE adjustments
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) = 0 THEN `co2_emissions_selected` WHEN `category` = 'Hotel' THEN `emissions_forecast_hotel` WHEN `category` = 'Car' THEN `emission_forecast_car` ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` END

columns.description: Emissions forecast with efficiency adjustments (Hotel: 2% annual, Air: 30% shift with 10% gain + 1.5% annual improvement)
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) = 0 THEN `emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE` WHEN `category` = 'Hotel' THEN `emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE` * POWER(1 - 0.02, YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT)) WHEN `category` = 'Air' THEN `emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE` * (1 - 0.30 * 0.10) * POWER(1 - 0.015, YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT)) ELSE `emissions_forecast_woEFF_woFTE` END

columns.description: Emissions forecast with efficiency and FTE growth (2% annual increase)
columns.expression: `emissions_forecast_wEFF_woFTE` * POWER(1 + 0.02, YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT))

columns.description: SAF forecast (placeholder - requires SAF budget and price parameters)
columns.expression: CASE WHEN `selected_year` <= MAKE_DATE(CAST(:base_year AS INT), 1, 1) THEN 0 ELSE 0 END

columns.description: Business as usual forecast with 2% FTE growth
columns.expression: CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT) = 0 THEN `co2_emissions_selected` ELSE `co2_emissions_selected` * POWER(1 + 0.02, YEAR(`selected_year`) - CAST(:base_year AS INT)) END

columns.description: Scenario forecast emissions in tCO2e with efficiency and FTE adjustments minus SAF
columns.expression: SUM(`emissions_forecast_wEFF_wFTE`) / 1000 - AVG(`forecast_saf`)

columns.description: Historical emissions up to base year in tCO2e
columns.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(`selected_year`) <= CAST(:base_year AS INT) THEN `co2_emissions_selected` ELSE 0 END) / 1000

columns.description: BAU forecast emissions in tCO2e
columns.expression: SUM(`Forecast_Emissions_BAU`) / 1000

columns.description: Combined past and forecast emissions
columns.expression: CASE WHEN `past_emission` IS NOT NULL AND `Forecast_Emissions_Scenario` IS NOT NULL THEN `past_emission` ELSE COALESCE(`past_emission`, 0) + COALESCE(`Forecast_Emissions_Scenario`, 0) END
